issue.title: Bug: Portchannels down after warm-boot on 202505

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

Broadcom

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

On 202505 before warm-boot, the portchannels are up, after same-image warm-boot, they are down.

The same behavior is seen when doing a 202411->202505 warm upgrade without CPA.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Install 202505 image and cold boot into it
2. Take a note of portchannel status with `show int portchannel` the ports and LACP sessions will be up at this point
3. Warm-boot the same image with `sudo warm-reboot -vvv`
4. Check portchannel status again with `show int portchannel` the ports and LACP sessions will be down at this point.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

After warm-boot, the portchannel status is:
```
admin@str-7060-cx32-1:~$ show int portchannel
Flags: A - active, I - inactive, Up - up, Dw - Down, N/A - not available,
       S - selected, D - deselected, * - not synced
  No.  Team Dev        Protocol     Ports
-----  --------------  -----------  -------------
  101  PortChannel101  LACP(A)(Dw)  Ethernet64(D)
  102  PortChannel102  LACP(A)(Dw)  Ethernet66(D)
  103  PortChannel103  LACP(A)(Dw)  Ethernet68(D)
  104  PortChannel104  LACP(A)(Dw)  Ethernet70(D)
```

But should be:

```
admin@str-7060-cx32-1:~$ show int portchannel
Flags: A - active, I - inactive, Up - up, Dw - Down, N/A - not available,
       S - selected, D - deselected, * - not synced
  No.  Team Dev        Protocol     Ports
-----  --------------  -----------  -------------
  101  PortChannel101  LACP(A)(Up)  Ethernet64(S)
  102  PortChannel102  LACP(A)(Up)  Ethernet66(S)
  103  PortChannel103  LACP(A)(Up)  Ethernet68(S)
  104  PortChannel104  LACP(A)(Up)  Ethernet70(S)
```
